statement: The recorded value is not safe or correct for this case because the court order currently in force requires post P-88 to remain taken down.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The recorded value is not safe or correct for this case because the court order currently in force requires post P-88 to remain taken down" directly asserts the record's "lifted" status contradicts the stated in-force order.
